Table of Contents PriyankaS3ri August 12, 2019 3:03 pm One of the most common questions from aspiring tech professionals is, “which language is used for web development?” While there isn’t just one answer, understanding the core languages used for web development is the first step toward a successful career. The specific language used in web development often depends on whether you’re working on the front-end or back-end. For example, back-end development has powerful options, with web development in Python becoming increasingly popular due to its simplicity and powerful libraries. This guide will walk you through the top choices, clarifying which language used for web development is right for your goals. The Need for Different Programming Languages in Web-Development Initially, websites used to be monologues or mere information scripts. But today, websites have become interactive. Technology enables the user to interact with the website, post concerns, seek answers, etc. Technically, this is termed as the client-side or the front-end of the website. On the other hand, the back-end could be called the website’s kitchen comprising of the server, the database, scripts, applications, etc. Both of these (front-end and back-end) are two different areas of operations and expertise offered by web developers. However, some developers offer comprehensive web development solutions. And yes, offering one-stop and comprehensive web solutions will always remain in vogue! Okay, so why is it required to learn different programming languages? It is necessary to understand both the above aspects of the web development business. Like I’ve said before, clients want comprehensive solutions. You cannot make a client run here and there, now and then! Hence, it is always good to gain expertise in more than one language. It will help you to maintain your competence. Different languages involve different levels of complexities, meant for different purposes. Let us have a look at the top 5 programming languages used for web development. Top 5 Programming Languages Used In Web Development Java Java was among the most primitive languages developed in the 1990s by Sun Microsystems. It was when the technology Big-Bang was yet to take place. It is termed a general-purpose programming language. Despite the several numbers of technological advancements that have happened, Java has always been in demand. It is the default language for the development of most Android apps. Java is considered to be a subset of the language C. It is a back-end or server-side technology. It is extremely versatile and can work on any platform. 3RI Technologies is one of the best choices for Java Classes in Pune JavaScript The advantage with JavaScript is that it runs on any browser, and can work with non-web-based programs. Fundamentally, it is a front-end language used for website development, desktop app, and game development. JavaScript facilitates both functional and object-based programming styles, further helping the user to create an appealing user interface along with intriguing games/ websites/ applications. It is somewhat imperative to have an understanding of JavaScript, as the algorithms, data structures, and components apply to other languages as well. Python One good thing about Python is that it is an easy-to-learn language. It is the latest entrant in the world of web development languages and is perceived to be a dynamic and all-purpose language. Python is known to be a back-end language and formulated in a way to be simple, readable, and at the same time, interesting. Python’s flexible and dynamic nature has made it extremely popular amongst web developers, and therefore holds bright prospects in the future. .NET .NET is Microsoft formulated software framework, principally meant to run on Microsoft Windows. It includes the Framework Class Library (FCL) and facilitates language interoperability. FCL offers data access, database connectivity, user interface, cryptography, numeric algorithms, network communications, and web application development. .NET framework is commonly used in the new apps developed for the Windows platform. PHP This is an HTML-embedded scripting language. It is widely used to create dynamic web pages and useful for front and back-end developers. With PHP expanding web apps and operating websites that carry out recurring tasks such as news updates etc. it is simple and quick. PHP is open-source. It is popular amongst start-ups, e-commerce portals, etc. Some other popular programming languages used in web development are C, C++, Ruby, SQL, etc. 3RI Technologies is one of the best institutes imparting education on all these programming languages. If the data is huge and cannot be analyzed using regular software, then it is called Big Data, and its analysis is called Big Data Analytics. Software such as Visual is used to analyze this data and take out useful insights from it. Data Mining is an important analytic process designed to explore data. A most important task in data mining is to extract non-trivial nuggets from large amounts of data. Machine Learning is a sub-field of data science that focuses on designing algorithms that can learn from and make predictions on the data. Machine learning includes Supervised Learning and Unsupervised Learning methods.
